scope: Local review/correction interface upgrade. No retraining, GitHub publication, new remote CI run or new Docker verification in this check.

live_workflow.qualification: Development regression cases, including fresh wording. Cases informed fixes; not an independent estimate of general language accuracy. Explanation failure deliberately induced with a nonexistent model against real Ollama.

real_model_ui_recovery.method: Streamlit AppTest with real local Ollama parsing, released housing model inference and real Ollama explanation retry. A test-only subclass changes the first explanation request to a nonexistent model, causing an actual HTTP 404. No simulated feature values or price responses.

browser_checks.method: Interactive local-browser checks with actual Ollama and released housing pipeline
browser_checks.quick_example: Four required fields and ten disclosed defaults; displayed $160,001
browser_checks.fresh_full_example: All fourteen inputs supplied with source quotes; displayed $219,776
browser_checks.price_before_explanation: Browser snapshot captured the saved price while the explanation request was still running, before the generated summary appeared
browser_checks.correction: Garage capacity 2 to 1 displayed explicitly, other details retained, confirmation reset, previous estimate marked outdated; reconfirmed price $219,138
browser_checks.chicago_after_estimate: Visible scope refusal, previous price removed, confirmation and estimate disabled
browser_checks.responsive_layout: Visually checked at 1280x720 and 752x912; outer columns stack at the narrower size

housing_model.inference: Load verified saved preprocessing/Random Forest pipeline and call predict; no fitting in the app.

limits: This report records initial native verification. Subsequent Docker checks are recorded in reports/docker_verification.json; remote checks are recorded by GitHub Actions.
Cold loading and long descriptions may take noticeably longer on older hardware.
Structured extraction and quote checks cannot guarantee correct language understanding; user review remains necessary.
